title: Mint and Coriander Raita
summary: Creamy whole-milk yoghurt with chopped mint and coriander, ground cumin, lemon, a little garlic and a pinch of cayenne.

ingredients.item: fresh mint, finely chopped, plus leaves to serve
garlic cloves, grated to a paste
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Smooth the yoghurt
steps.text: Beat the yoghurt in the bowl until creamy and lump-free.

steps.title: Add herbs and spices
steps.text: Stir in the mint and coriander, cumin, lemon juice, garlic, salt and cayenne.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate for at least 15 min so the herbs scent the yoghurt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Give it a stir, spoon into a serving bowl and top with a few mint leaves. Serve cold with curries, biryani or grilled meats.

tips: Toast whole cumin seeds in a dry pan and crush them for a deeper flavour.
If your yoghurt is very thick, loosen it with 1-2 tbsp cold water.
Chop the herbs just before using so they stay bright green.
Leave out the cayenne for children.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. The herbs darken slightly over time. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
